goal_rule: count target = ceiling(prior seven-day observed daily mean * horizon * case factor); inventory infeasible target = observed remaining stock + 1; profit objective maximizes without inventing a target
tuning_rule: Only development cases may inform prompt changes; freeze prompt and schema hashes before held-out model calls. Any post-held-out tuning requires a new evaluation version and new held-out cases.
evidence_rule: Planner receives observable synthetic facts only, never scenario instructions, seed, hidden demand/quality/elasticity coefficients, future events, target-generation formulas, arm labels or counterfactual outcomes.
report_rule: Retain all attempted cases and errors, no-action and unfavorable results. Reproduction is not additional independent evidence. No win requirement.
paired_statistics: Per-case/seed paired differences; descriptive mean, median and range. Tiny held-out suite does not establish population significance or merchant causal lift.
